scripts.build: bun run build:contract && bun run build:web && bun run build:cli
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:contract && bun run typecheck:only
scripts.typecheck:only: bun run --cwd packages/contract typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/cli typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/web typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build:contract && bun run test:only
scripts.verify: bun run build:contract && bun run typecheck:only && bun run test:only
scripts.prepare: lefthook install || echo 'WARNING: lefthook install failed — git hooks are NOT active (no gitleaks secret scan, no format/lint on commit). Run `bun run prepare` again once git and lefthook are available.'
